overloadPatches.semanticRole: Loads the entire contents of an existing, unopened document into a BLOB.

overloadMerges.note: blob is filled with the document contents in place (docs: 'BLOB field or variable to receive the document' / 'Document contents'), so direction is inout rather than the draft's default in.

params.name: document
params.description: Name of an existing document that is not already open

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB field or variable that receives the document contents

constraints: document must name an existing document that is not already open, otherwise an error is generated.
To let the user choose the document interactively, use Open document with its process variable Document instead of a literal name.
